title: Repairman Mallworld dream
content: I’ve recently been having reoccurring dreams about a large water slide in mallworld that’s “out of commission” it’s taped off and unaccessable. However the other night I dreamt I was on a repairman team that was hired to repair the slide. The water slide is very dimly lit inside and has moving cables exposed. In the latest iteration of this dream I was at the bottom of the slide waiting for my repairman partner to meet me there, it was leading to an outside pool area that was vacant. There were empty shacks around the outside of mallworld full old tools and keepsakes.
